text:
Aisha (Recruiter): Quick one — offer drafted for Elena (Candidate) for L4 IC, remote (UK). Hiring manager asking to place at Band S4 and include a split sign-on (50% at start, 50% at 3 months). Proposed comp: Base GBP 95,000; Sign-on GBP 8,000 (4k + 4k); Equity: standard grant. Need people-ops + finance + legal eyes before I send. @Diego (Hiring Manager) can you confirm business rationale? :pray:
Diego (Hiring Manager): Confirmed — Elena's background (senior frontend infra at Acme) justifies S4. Team has capacity constraints, ramp needs immediate coverage. I can approve the band increase from my side but need sign-off on sign-on amount from finance. Start date target 2026-04-15.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks — can you drop the formal justification snippet here (2–3 lines) and attach the comp spreadsheet row? Also flagging policy: sign-ons > GBP 5k require comp committee review or exec approval depending on reason.
Aisha (Recruiter): Paste of justification: "Critical hire for infra stability; 6 months to ROI; competing offer at GBP 100k + 6k sign-on — parity needed." Spreadsheet row: https://redwood.example/comp/q2-2026#row-ELENA (internal link).
Luca (Finance): Noted. Finance rule is: sign-on <= GBP 5,000 — ok with budget owner approval; >GBP 5,000 needs comp committee or VP finance approval. GBP 8,000 falls into committee path. Please route with cost breakdown. Also include Fx assumptions (GBP->USD).
Maya (Legal): From legal, no contract blockers for remote UK hire. If payment schedule is split, ensure offer letter spells out payment conditions and clawback if leaving before 3mo. We have a standard clause; I'll attach the template.
OfferBot: Offer record created — ID OFF-2026-00421. Current status: pending_people_ops_review. Routing tags: #comp-committee #finance #legal.
Priya (People Ops): OK, routing plan: 1) Aisha to add short business case + spreadsheet row, 2) People Ops to pre-approve band S4 conditionally, 3) Route to comp-committee for sign-on approval, 4) Once committee approves, legal will finalize offer letter. ETA: committee meeting tomorrow EOD if packet submitted by 14:00 UTC.
Aisha (Recruiter): Packet submitted (link above) and added candidate CV + manager note. @Luca any chance of an expedited VP finance sign-off instead of committee? Diego can he escalate?
Diego (Hiring Manager): I can ping VP finance but committee slot is fastest this cycle. I'll escalate anyway in parallel.
Luca (Finance): Happy to be looped in. If Diego gets VP sign-off before committee, we can skip committee. Otherwise we'll take it to the committee today. Please include the following in the packet: expected first 3 months headcount ROI, headcount delta, cost amortization.
Priya (People Ops): Conditional: band S4 approved pending committee sign-on decision and VP/Finance confirmation of budget. People Ops will prepare offer letter draft with Maya's clawback clause pre-populated.
Maya (Legal): I'll prepare clause and review final offer language once committee decision is in.
Aisha (Recruiter): Thanks all — I'll wait for committee or VP so we don't risk retracting. Will update thread once we have a decision. :thumbsup:
OfferBot: Reminder scheduled — if no decision by 14:00 UTC, auto-escalate to VP Finance at 14:05 UTC.
